classification_read.finding: 8A66.0 convulsive>=5min;8A66.10 absence>10min;generic parent not treated as all phenotypes identical.8A67 repeated seizures with recovery excluded.

findings.resolution: Four actionable/risk claims reclassified; semantic two-source checks performed.
NICE/RCOG dependence removed from two-source count; actual MSD magnesium/postpartum source added.
2011 Mayo author original age/etiology read; no old treatment or numerical prognosis extrapolated.
Actual PNES child page supports video EEG and involuntary symptoms; retains ICS/DGN.
All Hopkins references removed; critical and explanation supports replaced by actual-read CC/ICS without duplicate same-source support.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Convulsive emergency5min not universal NCSEdiagnostic threshold;absence>10min classification. Comatose NCSE and awake EPC/absence escalation individualized,adultguidelines not universal pediatric/obstetric regimens. Refractory treatment benefits/risks and prognosis uncertainty explicit.

resolution: Fourteen dimensions and bilingual text reviewed claim by claim; actionable/risk/threshold claims have two independently authored supports after disclosed dependency correction. Lay explanations distinguish electrical seizure,EEG limitations,firstaid,rescueplan,ICU risks and subtype-specific causes. Editorial acceptance only; Hopkins inaccessible source removed.

category_decisions.rationale: Convulsive emergency recognition5min and escalation/risks covered.
Absence sustained impaired awareness,EEG,distinct escalation;does not require convulsion.
Other specified NCSE with coma versus altered behavior distinguished.
Other specified status includes lay EPC motor/awareness branch,underlying focal causes and individualized care;EPC not restricted to Rasmussen.
Unspecified status acute safety and etiologic/subtype clarification covered.
